name: @mm/rules-magic
description: Grid legality, nodes, knowledge instances, and tradition hooks. Skeleton — the rules land in knowledge-model.
author: Ann Kelner
//: Rules-path code: no third-party runtime dependencies, no Node built-ins, integer-only. Per contracts.md §5 it may import sim-core, content, state and primitives — and MUST NOT import rules-world or agent-api. @mm/content is imported for TYPES ONLY, as in @mm/state: its public surface re-exports a loader that reads the filesystem, so a value import would make this package Node-bound in an Electron renderer.
